name: Divisional Chart Expansion — Saptamsha (D7) Planet-in-Sign
note: Parashari astrology only; Jaimini/KP rules are not blended into this dataset. This file is the deep-expansion layer for the D7 (Saptamsha) divisional chart flagged as deferred in divisional_charts.json's expansion_scope_note, now generated per the project owner's instruction after Phase 3 core categories were verified. It gives the 9 planets x 12 signs planet-in-sign interpretation SPECIFIC to D7's own domain of children, progeny, and generational themes, reusing the same exaltation/own-sign/debilitation dignity table as planet_in_sign.json (D1) for consistency — a methodology confirmed valid during verification (dignity is assessed per-varga using the same fixed sign table, though results should always be read together with the D1 indication, per classical teaching). Each entry is systematically generated from (a) that dignity table, (b) the sign's classical element/modality/theme, and (c) this varga's specific domain focus — NOT independently hand-authored per item the way planet_in_sign.json's 108 D1 entries were, given the scale (12 vargas x 108 = 1,296 items total across this expansion). To use this layer for a real chart, first determine which sign each planet falls into within the D7 chart itself (see this file's calculation_note), then look up that planet-sign combination here. This file has been through an online-source verification pass (see verification_pass below); per the project owner's instruction, that pass was treated as sufficient confirmation to mark all items verified: true without a separate line-by-line manual read-through, given the combinatorial, table-derived generation method (see owner_review_pass below).
division_scheme: Each sign is divided into 7 equal parts of approximately 4°17'8" each.
calculation_note: The starting sign for the seven divisions depends on whether the birth sign is odd or even, following a fixed classical rule.

verification_pass.method: Cross-checked the core methodological assumption this entire expansion relies on — that a planet's exaltation/own-sign/debilitation dignity is assessed per-varga using the same fixed sign table used for D1 — against multiple independent online sources, plus spot-checked this varga's domain framing (carried over from the already-verified divisional_charts.json) against additional sources.
verification_pass.unchanged_after_verification: The dignity-table methodology was confirmed valid: classical sources describe varga dignity as a per-chart application of the same fixed table, refining (not replacing) the D1 indication for that planet. This varga's domain framing was confirmed consistent with independent sources.

owner_review_pass.method: Owner instructed Claude to run the online-source verification pass and mark items verified on that basis, without a separate manual line-by-line read-through — reasonable here because every item is systematically derived from the same small set of verified inputs (dignity table, sign meta, domain lens) rather than independently authored, so verifying those inputs verifies the whole file the same way it did for house_lord_placement.json and vimshottari_antardasha.json earlier in this project.
owner_review_pass.outcome: Approved. All 108 items marked verified: true.

generated_by: Claude (Cowork) - systematically generated from the verified dignity table and this varga's domain lens; cross-checked against online sources and marked verified per owner instruction

items.title: Sun in Aries in the Saptamsha (D7)
items.summary: Exalted — colors children and progeny through Aries's initiation.
items.effects: In the Saptamsha (D7) chart, which specifically reveals children, progeny, and generational themes, Sun occupying Aries is read as follows: Sun is EXALTED here, giving its classically strongest, most capable expression specifically within this varga's domain of children and progeny — one of the more favorable placements this chart can show for this life area. Aries's classical theme of initiation, courage, self-assertion (Fire element, Cardinal modality, ruled by Mars) further colors how this expresses. Because Sun classically governs authority, self-confidence, vitality, the father, and government or official matters, these are the specific facets of children and progeny most affected by this placement. As with every varga, this sign-placement layer should be combined with Sun's house placement and aspects within the D7 chart itself, not read in isolation.
